extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Cigna plan available in Lee County has a $30 monthly premium, a $410 drug deductible and a $5700 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The call was compliant with the CMS contract year 2027 marketing rules. The disclaimer was delivered and compliant with the ordering:before-benefits basis. The SOA was collected and the appointment was scheduled.
composition.coaching_note: Grace, you did a great job delivering the TPMO disclaimer before discussing any benefits. It's important to ensure that the customer understands the limitations of the plans offered. Keep up the good work!

crm_record.next_step: Follow up with the customer for the signed Scope of Appointment and confirm the appointment time.
